note: The Maccabees removed the stones of the defiled altar from the Holy Temple (according to tradition, see the historical book 1 Maccabees 4:43). The memorial of Rabbi Daniel Zion (of blessed memory), a Messianic Jewish pioneer who died in 1979 CE (5740). Rabbi Zion was one of the chief rabbis of Bulgaria during World War II and a believer in Yeshua. He helped save 800 Jews from the Nazis, but ended up a prisoner himself. He survived and, in 1949, he moved to Israel.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something about God?
